CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
November 23, 2021 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

PRESENTATION BY DISTRICT 57 ASSEMBLYMEMBER LISA CALDERON – It is recommended the City Council receive a presentation by District 57 Assemblymember Lisa Calderon.

70th ANNIVERSARY RECOGNITION - It is recommended the City Council present Howard and Lola Leggett with a 70th Wedding Anniversary certificate and two tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts.
5.2 70th Anniversary Recognition
5.3
RECOGNITION OF FORMER LA MIRADA COMMUNITY FOUNDATION MEMBER - It is recommended the City Council present an appreciation plaque and tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts to Lesley Watkins for her years of dedicated service to the community.
5.3 Recognition for Former Foundation Member
5.4
RECOGNITION OF BIOLA UNIVERSITY'S MEN'S AND WOMEN'S SWIMMING & DIVING TEAMS - It is recommended the City Council recognize the athletes and coaches of the Biola University Men's and Women's Swimming & Diving Teams and present them with Certificates of Recognition.

RECOGNITION OF EMPLOYEE FOR YEARS OF SERVICE - It is recommended the City Council recognize Joshua Bessom for his years of service and present him with a service award pin and a certificate of appreciation.

8.
PUBLIC HEARING
8.1
ORDINANCE NO. 721 REESTABLISHING AND MODIFYING THE CITY COUNCIL DISTRICTS ENACTED BY THIS COUNCIL'S PASSAGE OF ITS ORDINANCE NO. 684 ON NOVEMBER 8, 2016 - It is recommended the City Council conduct a Public Hearing to receive input from the community regarding the redrawing of election district boundaries and adopt Ordinance No. 721 reestablishing and modifying the City Council Districts enacted by this Council's passage of its Ordinance No. 684 on November 8, 2016.
8.1 Redistricting of Council Districts
8.2
TENTATIVE PARCEL MAP NO. 82582, CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 330, ADMINISTRATIVE ADJUSTMENT NO. 52, A SITE PLAN REVIEW, AND THE ASSOCIATED NEGATIVE DECLARATION TO: CONSOLIDATE TWO PARCELS INTO ONE; CONSTRUCT A 70,092 SQUARE FOOT ADDITION TO THE EXISTING BUILDING; AND INSTALL TWO EXTERIOR GROUND MOUNTED CARBON DIOXIDE TANKS AT 14405 ARTESIA BOULEVARD, WITHIN THE INDUSTRIAL (M-2) ZONING DISTRICT - It is recommended the City Council conduct a Public Hearing as prescribed by law; affirm the findings of the Negative Declaration; and adopt Resolution No. 21-33 approving Tentative Parcel Map No. 82582, Conditional Use Permit No. 330, Administrative Adjustment No. 52, a Site Plan Review, and the associated Negative Declaration to: consolidate two parcels into one; construct a 70,092 square foot addition to the existing building; and install two exterior ground mounted carbon dioxide tanks at 14405 Artesia Boulevard, within the Industrial (M-2) Zoning District.
8.2 PH Reg. 14405 Artesia Blvd.
8.2 ISMND
8.2 Plans
8.2 Resolution

PUBLIC COMMENT: (Any information or materials provided during Public Comments are recorded in the minutes and are subject to public disclosure under the Public Records Act. The speaker is requested, but is not required, to orally state his or her name and/or address for purposes of recording the information accurately in the minutes. If the speaker declines to provide his or her name, address, and other relevant information, the records will so indicate. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council.)

APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of November 9, 2021 and the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of November 9, 2021.

PUMP ROOM CONTROLS UPGRADE PROJECT PHASE II - APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS - It is recommended the City Council find that pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act of 1970, the project is categorically exempt under Section 15301 Class 1 (c) and will have no significant effect on the environment; approve the plans and specifications for Capital Improvement Project No. 2021-09, Splash! Pump Room Upgrade Project Phase II; and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids.
